name: Japan
contextBlurb: Japan regulates fiat-pegged, par-redeemable stablecoins as electronic payment instruments under the Payment Services Act. Issuance and handling are limited to licensed entities under the FSA framework, with strong reserve, AML/CFT and consumer-protection requirements. On 7 July 2026, the FSA finalized an amendment adding five foreign jurisdictions to the scope of Japan's travel-rule requirements for cryptoasset and stablecoin transfers. The amendment takes effect on 3 August 2026.

stablecoinMeta.classificationNote: Electronic payment instrument (EPI) for fiat-backed, par-redeemable stablecoins. Other designs fall under crypto-assets or, if structured as investment contracts, potentially securities.

regulators.name: Financial Services Agency
regulators.role: Primary regulator for EPIs and crypto-asset intermediaries (licensing, AML/CFT, consumer protection, ongoing supervision).

regulators.name: Bank of Japan
regulators.role: Leads CBDC research; monitors monetary and financial stability; coordinates with FSA/MOF on systemic issues.
